function.name: login_user
function.description: Logs in the user to authenticate the user to access their account. Returns true or false for login success or failure.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: logout_user
function.description: Logs out the user if the user was previously logged in. Returns true always because of successful logout.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: show_available_book
function.description: Retrieves a list of books available for borrowing. Returns a list of books available for borrowing.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: borrow_book
function.description: Allows a user to borrow a book and sets its return date. Returns true or false for successful book borrowing.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

function.name: return_book
function.description: Allows a user to return a borrowed book and updates their late count if the book is overdue. Returns true or false for successful book return.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

function.name: check_return_date
function.description: Retrieves the return date for the user's specified borrowed book. Returns the return date for the user's specified borrowed book.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

function.name: get_account_balance
function.description: Retrieves the current balance of the user's account. Returns the float account balance or None if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: credit_balance
function.description: Adds a specified amount to the user's account balance. Returns true or false for successful addition of funds to the user's account balance.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

amount.description: the amount of money specified by the function description.

function.name: pay_late_fee
function.description: Deducts the total late fee from the user's account balance. Returns true or false for successful deduction of late fees from the user's account balance.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: update_membership
function.description: Updates the user's restricted access status and deducts the monthly fee from their balance. Returns the new expiration date of the restricted access or None if the update condition is not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: add_book
function.description: Adds a new book to the library database. Returns true or false for successful addition of a new book to the library database.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

count.description: the number of copies of a book to add or remove from the library's database.

restricted.description: a boolean indicating whether a book is restricted.

function.name: remove_book
function.description: Removes a book from the library database. Returns true or false for successful removal of a book from the library database.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

function.name: show_available_rooms
function.description: Retrieves a dictionary of rooms with their available slots to reserve. Returns a dictionary of a dictionary of rooms with their available slots to reserve.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: reserve_room
function.description: Reserves the specified room for the user on the specified date for a list of specified slots. Returns true or false for successful room reservation.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

room_id.description: a string representing the id of a library room to reserve

resv_date.description: a string representing the date when the user want to reserve a room.

slots.description: a list of time slots that the user want to reserve a certain room on a specified day.

function.name: internal_check_username_exist
function.description: Checks if a specific username exists in the Library database. Returns true if the inputted username of the account does exist in the database.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_convert_book_title_to_id
function.description: Converts a book title to the corresponding book id. Returns a string representing the book id.

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

function.name: internal_check_book_exist
function.description: Checks if a book title exists in the library database. Returns true or false based on the existence of the book title in the library database.

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

function.name: internal_check_book_available
function.description: Checks if a book is available for borrowing. Returns true or false based on the availability of a book for borrowing.

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

function.name: internal_get_user_borrowed
function.description: Retrieves a list of user's borrowed books. Returns a list of user's borrowed books' ids.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_get_user_num_borrowed
function.description: Retrieves the number of books the user has borrowed. Returns an integer of the number of books the user has borrowed.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_calculate_late_fee
function.description: Calculates the user's late fee based on their number of late returns. Returns a float of the late fee the user has to pay.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_get_membership_fee
function.description: Retrieves the restricted access monthly fee from the database. Returns a floar representing the restricted access monthly fee.

function.name: internal_is_restricted
function.description: Checks if a book is marked as restricted. Returns true or false based on whether a book is marked as restricted.

book_title.description: the title of the book to be borrowed, returned, or managed.

function.name: internal_get_membership_status
function.description: Retrieves the restricted access status of a user. Returns a string representing the expiration date of the user's restricted access status or none if the user don't have a restricted access.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_is_admin
function.description: Checks if a user has admin privileges. Returns true or false based on whether the user has admin privileges.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_get_num_reserved_slots
function.description: Counts the number of the user's reserved slots based on their current reservation. Returns an integer of the number of reserved slots in the user's current reservation

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_check_room_exist
function.description: Checks if a specified room id exists in the database. Returns true or false based on the existence of the specified room id in the database.

room_id.description: a string representing the id of a library room to reserve

function.name: internal_check_date_available_for_the_room
function.description: Checks if the specified date is available for the room. Returns true or false based on the availability of the specified date for the specified room.

room_id.description: a string representing the id of a library room to reserve

resv_date.description: a string representing the date when the user want to reserve a room.

function.name: internal_all_slots_available_for_the_room_on_the_date
function.description: Checks if the provided slots are alll available for the specified room on the specified date. Returns true or false based on the availability of time slots for the specified room on the specified date.

room_id.description: a string representing the id of a library room to reserve

resv_date.description: a string representing the date when the user want to reserve a room.

slots.description: a list of time slots that the user want to reserve a certain room on a specified day.

function.name: internal_get_interaction_date
function.description: Retrieves the current interaction date from the database. Returns the current interaction date recorded in the database.

function.name: internal_convert_human_date_to_iso
function.description: Converts a verbalized date string to an ISO 8601 formatted date string ('YYYY-MM-DD'). Returns an ISO 8601 formatted date string ('YYYY-MM-DD').

date_string.description: the date in a human-readable string format,where the month is an English word (e.g., 'January'), the day is a number followed by a proper suffix (e.g., '1st', '2nd', '4th'), and the year is a four-digit number (e.g., '2024'). Example: 'January 25th, 2024'.

function.name: internal_convert_iso_to_human_date
function.description: Converts an ISO 8601 formatted date string ('YYYY-MM-DD') to a verbalized date string. Returns a verbalized date string.
